meta.policy: nursery.mjs scripted behaviour policy (50% uniform random action, else scripted)

sanity.note: rebuilt nursery logs; the base must equal refs.json ansMemoryless

results.name: base: (OBS, ACTION)
results.view: none: the token stream as it is

results.name: kind trace, unlimited
results.view: no change to the view; needs memory kept beyond the trunk's reach (the trace is a function of the being's own past tokens)

results.name: kind trace within reach
results.view: no change to the view; the trace is a function of the being's own past tokens inside the trunk's feed-forward window

results.name: witness, 4 ticks
results.view: changes the view: it shows other valleys (VIEW_KERNEL: "other valleys")

results.name: witness, 16 ticks
results.view: changes the view: it shows other valleys (VIEW_KERNEL: "other valleys")

results.name: season turn flag
results.view: changes the view: it shows the season clock (VIEW_KERNEL: "the season index and clock")

results.name: season age (0-31, 32-127, 128+)
results.view: changes the view: it shows the season clock (VIEW_KERNEL: "the season index and clock")

results.name: group field (others down, others warned)
results.view: changes the view: it shows other valleys (VIEW_KERNEL: "other valleys")

results.name: finer body (exact E and H)
results.view: changes the view: it shows exact E and H inside a band (VIEW_KERNEL), and so changes the OBS token itself

results.name: kind trace + witness 16
results.view: changes the view (the witness half): other valleys

results.name: kind trace + season age
results.view: changes the view (the season-age half): the season clock

results.name: reference ceiling: true effect of the item this season (not a sense)
kind trace kept up to 8 ticks old (extra)
results.view: no change to the view; needs memory kept beyond the trunk's reach (the trace is a function of the being's own past tokens)

results.name: kind trace kept up to 16 ticks old (extra)
results.view: no change to the view; needs memory kept beyond the trunk's reach (the trace is a function of the being's own past tokens)

results.name: kind trace kept up to 32 ticks old (extra)
results.view: no change to the view; needs memory kept beyond the trunk's reach (the trace is a function of the being's own past tokens)

results.name: kind trace within reach + witness 16 (extra, added after the report)
results.view: changes the view (the witness half): other valleys; the trace half needs no change to the view

results.name: kind trace within reach + witness 4 (extra, added after the report)
results.view: changes the view (the witness half): other valleys; the trace half needs no change to the view

witnessBesideReachTrace.note: held-out CE (add-0.5) on eats with an item only, split by what the trace has on that eat; counts fitted on all training records of the probe

witnessBySharedKind.note: held-out CE (add-0.5) on eats with an item, split by whether the fruit kind's effect was shared by all valleys that season
